title: What Claude discovered in viral DNA—and why it matters
standfirst: Anthropic’s agents identified an overlooked biological arrangement and gave scientists a concrete reason to investigate it. Its function, and the reliability of the discovery method, remain open questions.
summary: What Anthropic’s array-associated reverse transcriptase discovery establishes about biology and AI research—and what remains unproved.
claimBoundary: AI-assisted editorial analysis of Yoon and colleagues’ unrefereed ART preprint. This article does not independently reproduce the sequence analyses or experiments and is not an original experimental report.
